semantic.justification: Original GetDateRef from zforfind.cxx, operating on the native scanner owner and actual CalendarWrapper. THE_FUTURE and NF_TEST_CALENDAR remain disabled exactly as in the normal upstream build. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
